03-25-1504 is March 25, 1504 (Julian calendar, but we treat as Gregorian per rules).  
304 days later:  
March has 31 days → days left in March: 6 → 304 - 6 = 298 days left.  
April (30) + May (31) + June (30) + July (31) + August (31) + September (30) + October (31) = 214 days used → 298 - 214 = 84 days left into November.  
November has 30 days → 84 > 30 → into December: 84 - 30 = 54 days left → December has 31 days → 54 > 31 → into January 1505: 54 - 31 = 23 days.  
So January 23, 1505.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1505-01-23
